authority: Source-topology-derived protective boundary; Golden is one acceptable implementation, not the only layout.
grounding_policy: Protect all three electrically separated directions created at pole 36. Grounding may be installed at the adjacent branch poles or at pole 36 on each named direction. Three-phase short-circuit sets and phase-split sets are both acceptable when every direction is covered and physical identifiers are unique or explicitly left for controlled preissue completion.

safety_policy.permission: Contact the final permit issuer before work, communicate the work content, and obtain permission before entry.
safety_policy.sequence: Verify no voltage, ground the work-section ends, then begin work. At completion inspect for objects left on the tower, remove the work grounds, withdraw personnel, report and close out.
safety_policy.climbing: Before climbing verify line name and tower number; inspect pole base, guy wires and climbing steps.
safety_policy.weather: Work in good weather; stop in thunderstorms or wind force greater than 6. Different thresholds are not the approved plan.
safety_policy.grounding_fixation: After installation secure grounding leads on the tower and prevent swinging.
safety_policy.protection: Maintain safety-belt protection at height and prohibit ground personnel directly below the work area.
